description: A 9:16 copy of a landscape master without re-rendering the picture: the frame is fitted inside 1080x1920 (scaled up or down, never cropped) and padded with black above and below. Video as in master: H.264 crf 18, medium preset, BT.709 colour. The audio is copied as it is (audio codec copy), which suits motionex masters, whose audio is already AAC; when the source audio is not AAC, pass audio: {codec: "aac", bitrate_k: 192}. Override pad.color or pad.position for other bars.
